children: 5E Advanced Materials entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire specified assets of Searles Valley Minerals, including the Argus, Westend and Trona facilities, about 9,000 acres of Searles Lake brine resources, the Trona short-line railroad, and related utilities and water systems. Consideration includes approximately $3.4 million in cash, 8.3 million shares, and a $6.2 million senior unsecured promissory note. The section 363 bankruptcy sale remains subject to Bankruptcy Court approval and, for the railroad assets, Surface Transportation Board authorization; closing is expected in early October 2026 and requires a $10 million secured bridge financing from a Nirma Limited affiliate. Assets will transfer "as is, where is," with certain environmental and regulatory obligations preserved.
